set.users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate “{{name}}”? The user is signed out immediately, can no longer sign in and their API tokens stop working.
set.users.emailHint: Needed for reset links and “Forgot password”.
set.users.mustChangeOnFirstLogin: Require a password change at first login
set.users.mustChangeOnNextLogin: Require a password change at next login
set.users.oneTimePasswordWarning: This password is shown only now. Pass it on to the user through a secure channel.
set.users.ownAccountHint: Manage your own account under Settings (password, 2FA, passkeys).
set.users.ownAccountRoleLocked: You cannot change your own role.
set.users.randomPasswordConfirm: Generate a new random password for {{name}}? The current password stops working immediately and all browser sessions of {{name}} are ended.
set.users.randomPasswordHint: Generates a secure 16-character password. It is shown exactly once.
set.users.removePasskeysConfirm: Remove all passkeys of {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
set.users.reset2faConfirm: Really reset 2FA for {{name}}? Sign-in will then only require the password or a passkey.
set.users.reset2faHint: Turns off the authenticator app for this account, e.g. after a lost phone. The user can set up 2FA again afterwards.
set.users.resetLinkHint: {{email}} receives a link (valid for 24 hours, single use) and chooses a new password. The current password stays valid until then.
set.users.resetLinkUnavailableNoEmail: Cannot send: this user has no email address.
set.users.resetLinkUnavailableNoSmtp: Cannot send: SMTP or the public base URL is not configured (Settings → SMTP or Profile).
set.users.revokeAccessConfirm: Revoke the selected access of “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
set.users.revokeAccessDone: Revoked: {{tokens}} API tokens, {{dyndns}} DynDNS tokens, {{webhooks}} webhooks ({{deliveries}} deliveries discarded).
set.users.revokeAccessHint: If you suspect an account takeover: API tokens are revoked permanently, DynDNS tokens and webhooks are deactivated and pending deliveries are discarded. The password stays unchanged – generate a random password or send a reset link for that.
set.users.revokeAllAccess: Revoke all access (API tokens, DynDNS tokens, webhooks)
set.users.revokeAllAccessHint: Recommended if the account may be compromised. Scripts, DynDNS clients and webhooks of this user will stop working.
set.users.totpNotActive: 2FA is not enabled for this account.
set.users.totpUnreadable: The 2FA secret of this account cannot be decrypted – signing in is only possible with a passkey. Resetting fixes this.
set.users.zoneUnavailable: no longer present or server offline
set.users.zonesHiddenHint: Assigned zones that are currently not visible (deleted or server offline): {{count}}. Unselect to remove the permission.
set.users.zonesLoadPartial: Zones from {{servers}} could not be loaded.
set.zoneDetail.exportEmpty: The server returned an empty zone file – nothing was downloaded.
set.zoneDetail.exportTitle: Download the zone as a BIND zone file
set.zoneDetail.notifyNoPermission: NOTIFY requires write access to this zone.
set.zoneDetail.notifyOtherServersHint: Other servers ({{servers}}) do not send NOTIFY – with separate databases, trigger it there separately if needed.
set.zoneDetail.notifyTitle: Notify secondaries of changes via DNS NOTIFY (sent from {{server}})
set.zoneDetail.notifyUnsupportedKind: NOTIFY is only possible for zones of type Master, Producer or Slave (with secondary-do-renotify) – this zone is of type {{kind}}.
